segments.text: Here are four MW4 DMZ meta builds you need to try right now.
Number one, the HAN 86, the most picked long range rifle in DMZ. FSS IS300 muzzle, SA H86 barrel, KV Corsac Holo, FR4 retractable stock, and the sixty round drum.
Number two, the Hyeon Burst. FSS IS300, Mugi Ingoem barrel, Corsac Holo, sixty round drum, and the HYN Meipeul rear grip.
Number three, the Kastov 762 with the seventy five round drum. Gauge 12 Mono muzzle, BCS K barrel, Corsac Holo, and the Fireline grip.
Number four, the ISO Nightshade for close range. FSS Crackdown, ZLR Carbon 900 barrel, fifty round drum, Demo STP 1 grip, Visiv 5 laser, and the ISO Trace apex.
Which one is your main? Drop the number in the comments, and follow for daily DMZ meta.
